title: A checkable note: the Nullstellensatz degree of Tseitin formulas is the toggle width (cutwidth + 1 at degree three)
claim: Let G be a connected graph with an odd charge c, and T(G, c) its Tseitin formula written as polynomials one clause at a time (one polynomial per violating assignment of a vertex, plus the Boolean axioms). Over a field of characteristic 2 its Nullstellensatz degree is the maximum degree of G; over every other field it is the toggle width tgw(G), whatever the charge. With cw(G) + 1 <= tgw(G) <= cw(G) + floor(maxdegree/2) on at least 3 vertices (from CUTWIDTH-DEPTH-20261020-001B), the degree is cw(G) + 1 when the maximum degree is at most 3. In the +-1 binomial encoding the degree is exactly cw(G) for every connected G when products are measured after reduction modulo y^2 = 1, and lies between tgw(G) and cw(G) + maxdegree when they are measured before. The note proves these self-containedly; the new step is the duality between degree-d refutations and level-d pseudo-distributions for this encoding. replay.py (standard library only) checks the sweep refutation as an integer polynomial identity, the closed-form design against every axiom multiple, and the degrees by direct elimination on ten cubic graphs.
failure_conditions: replay.py fails on a declared graph: the sweep refutation is not 1 over the integers, the design fails an axiom multiple, or a directly computed degree differs from the stated value.
A number in the note's table or remarks differs from the replay.
The note fails to compile, or leaves an undefined reference.
A control is accepted: an even charge refuted, the design surviving at level tgw, or the sweep without one step summing to 1.
A published statement of the exact degree is found (the ticket's stop rule).
foundation_claim_scope: Presentation of a proof-complexity result for an external reader; no contact-first claim.

validation.status: checked: self-contained prose proofs in the note; replay.py (standard library only) verifies the sweep refutation as an integer identity, the closed-form design against every axiom multiple over F3, F5 and Q, and the degrees by direct elimination over F2 and F3 and by signed union-find for the +-1 encoding, on ten cubic graphs with four negative controls; check.py ties every number in the note to the replay, identifies the roster, builds the PDF cleanly and catches five tampering controls; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with executable certificates on declared instances; the duality lemma is new here; Theorem 2 is inherited from CUTWIDTH-DEPTH-20261020-001B-P001 and its Lemma 9 restated with proof from Fomin and Thilikos (2003); no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: A targeted search on 2026-10-20 (Tseitin with Nullstellensatz, polynomial calculus, Sherali-Adams and affine relaxations, rank, cutwidth, Weisfeiler-Leman; Grigoriev 1998; Buss, Grigoriev, Impagliazzo and Pitassi 2001; Galesi, Talebanfard and Toran 2020; Wainwright and Jordan 2004; Makedon and Sudborough 1989) found no statement of the exact degree. The methods are standard, and the +-1 statement after reduction may be close to known arguments for binomial systems.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-20.
